language.label: Language
language.tooltip: Languages are read from the "translations" folder

location.label: Location
location.tooltip: Path to the game folder (NOT the data folder)

instanceLocation.label: Instance Location
instanceLocation.tooltip: Path to the MO2 instance folder (Folder Icon > Open Instance folder in MO2)

location.help: Location recommended to be a mod folder. Cannot be in your data folder. Avoid deleting old output before running if output is set to a mod folder.
location.tooltip: Path to the output folder - This folder should be used EXCLUSIVELY for PGPatcher

zip.label: Zip Output (Keep disabled if outputting to a mod folder)
zip.tooltip: Zip the output folder after processing

pluginLang.label: Plugin Language
pluginLang.tooltip: Language of embedded strings in output plugin. If a translation for this language is not available for a record, the default will be used which is usually English.

fixMeshLighting.label: Fix Mesh Lighting (ENB Only)
fixMeshLighting.tooltip: Fixes glowing meshes (For ENB users only!)

parallaxToCM.label: Upgrade Parallax to Complex Material
parallaxToCM.tooltip: Upgrades parallax textures and meshes to complex material when required for compatibility (highly recommended)

disablePrePatchedMaterials.label: Disable Pre-Patched Materials
disablePrePatchedMaterials.tooltip: Restores shaders to default if parallax or complex material textures are missing (highly recommended, replaces auto parallax functionality)

fixSSS.label: Fix Vanilla Subsurface Scattering
fixSSS.tooltip: Fixes subsurface scattering in meshes, especially foliage

hairFlowMap.label: Add Hair Flow Map (CS Only)
hairFlowMap.tooltip: Adds flow maps to texture sets for those that match the normal texture

processing.title: Processing
processing.help: These options are used to customize output generation. Avoid changing these unless you know what you are doing.

multithreading.label: Multithreading
multithreading.tooltip: Speeds up runtime at the cost of using more resources

devMode.label: Enable Mod Dev Mode
devMode.tooltip: Enables certain warnings to help those developing mods to work with PGPatcher

debugLogging.label: Enable Debug Logging
debugLogging.tooltip: Enables debug logging in the output log

traceLogging.label: Enable Trace Logging
traceLogging.tooltip: Enables trace logging in the output log (very verbose)

confirmLoadConfig.title: Confirm Load Config
confirmLoadConfig.message: Are you sure you want to load the config from the file? This action will overwrite all current unsaved settings.

confirmRestoreDefaults.title: Confirm Restore Defaults
confirmRestoreDefaults.message: Are you sure you want to restore the default settings? This action cannot be undone.

meshAllowlist.title: Mesh Rules Allowlist
meshAllowlist.description: If any rules exist here, only meshes matching them will be patched. Enter path to mesh like "meshes/armor/helmet.nif" or use wildcards (* is the wildcard) to allowlist entire folders/files. Right click to add/remove entries.

meshBlocklist.title: Mesh Rules Blocklist
meshBlocklist.description: Any meshes matching rules here will not be patched. Enter path to mesh like "meshes/armor/helmet.nif" or use wildcards (* is the wildcard) to blocklist entire folders/files. Right click to add/remove entries.

textureRules.title: Texture Rules
textureRules.description: Use this to tell PGPatcher what type of texture something is if the auto detection is wrong (very rare). Enter the full path to the texture like "textures/armor/helmet.dds" and select the type of texture. Wildcards are NOT supported here. A texture can be ignored by setting it to "unknown". Right click to add/remove entries.

recTypeSelector.title: Allowed Record Types
recTypeSelector.description: Unchecking a record type will exclude it and its associated meshes from being patched. Only record types with models are shown.

completion.title: PGPatcher Generation Complete
completion.message:
PGPatcher has completed generating output.

Processing Time: %lld seconds
Output Location:
%s

helpButton.tooltip: Open the PGPatcher Error Message wiki

conflictManager.title: Conflict Manager
conflictManager.help: Please sort your mods to determine what mod PGPatcher uses to patch meshes where. Selecting mods will show conflicts. The mod you have selected wins over mods that are green, and loses over mods that are red.

helpButton.tooltip: Open the PGPatcher Mod Window wiki

showAllMeshes.label: Show All Meshes
showAllMeshes.tooltip: View all meshes, shapes, and matches regardless of conflicts

lockMO2Order.label: Lock to MO2 Loose File Order
lockMO2Order.tooltip: Locks order to MO2. Enable/disable is still enabled. Keep in mind that PG conflicts are not the same as loose file conflicts.

restoreDefaultOrder.label: Restore Default Order
restoreDefaultOrder.tooltip: For MO2 default order is your loose file order. For vortex default order is by shader, then by name alphabetically.

confirmUnsavedChanges.title: Unsaved Changes
confirmUnsavedChanges.message: You have unsaved changes, are you sure you want to close?

confirmRestoreDefaultOrder.title: Confirm Restore Default Order
confirmRestoreDefaultOrder.message: Are you sure you want to restore default mod order and enable any manually disabled mods?

confirmRerunPatching.title: Re-run Patching
confirmRerunPatching.message: Are you sure you want to re-run the patching step?

confirmDiscardChanges.title: Confirm Discard Changes
confirmDiscardChanges.message: Are you sure you want to discard all changes?

errors.saveUserConfig: Failed to save user configuration to user.json

matchViewer.title: Match Viewer
